title: Coefficient estimates and Bohr phenomenon for analytic functions involving semigroup generator
summary: This article investigates the Bohr phenomenon and sharp coefficient problems for the class $\mathcal{A}_β$, a subclass of analytic self-maps of the unit disk with the holomorphic generators of one-parameter continuous semigroups. By integrating concepts from complex dynamics and geometric function theory, we derive sharp improvements to the classical Bohr radius by incorporating multiple Schwarz functions and certain functional expressions.
